summary_text:
LEGAL SUMMARY:

The case is listed in the LPC (Local Police Court) Register with permission granted by the Hon’ble District and Session Judge Adilabad, by Order No. 1044/2018/crl dated 07.03.2018, to enter the case in the LPC Register.

The matter is pending before the Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, Smt. Shaik Rehana, CC.

The case is between:  
The State of Telangana, represented by Sub-Inspector of Police, Neelwai (Complainant),  
and Satwaji @ Sudhakaranna and others (Accused).

The case is cited as No. 136 of 1998.

The order of entry into the LPC Register was given on 07.03.2018.  
The record was duly signed and sealed by the Junior Civil Judge, Chennur, on 13.03.2018.

[Note: The specific nature of the offense, the date of filing, the accused’s full name, or the jurisdiction of the case beyond the listed facts is not available in the evidence provided.]
